features.derivation: Direct recorded supplier reliability score in [0.0, 1.0]
features.business_meaning: Supplier historical score indicating baseline reliability.
features.missing_value_handling: Imputed via group/global median if missing.

features.derivation: Expanding mean of delay_days from previous shipments of the supplier (shift(1))
features.availability: Available at order creation (strictly prior shipments)
features.business_meaning: Supplier empirical track record of average delay days up to this order.
features.missing_value_handling: Neutral training fallback (0.0 days) for suppliers with no prior history.

features.business_meaning: Planned delivery transit days scheduled at order placement.
features.missing_value_handling: Calculated deterministically from order and expected delivery dates.

features.derivation: Inventory units on hand at origin/distribution node at order time
features.business_meaning: Stock availability to fulfill demand and absorb supply shocks.

features.derivation: Projected market demand for product SKU at order placement
features.business_meaning: Demand pressure on the supply chain node.

features.availability: Available at order creation / dispatch booking

features.derivation: Haversine great-circle formula between hubs + 1.25 highway circuity factor
features.business_meaning: Estimated route distance in kilometers between origin and destination.
features.missing_value_handling: Fallback to intra-city minimum (35 km) if hubs match or coordinates missing.

features.derivation: Modality chosen: Road, Rail, Air, or Sea
Indian seasonal mapping (Winter, Summer, Monsoon, Post-Monsoon)
features.business_meaning: Weather and seasonal monsoon demand cycle.

features.derivation: Urgency rating: Low, Medium, High, or Critical
features.business_meaning: Priority level influencing carrier dispatch speed.

targets.business_meaning: Non-negative delay in days (0 indicates on-time arrival).
